hook: Your map shows a whole country hiding inside another one.
title: A Country Fully Locked Inside Another
description:
Lesotho is an independent country completely surrounded by South Africa. Its border circles it on every side, so there is no way in or out without crossing South Africa. Only a few countries in the world are enclaves like this. Part of Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Lesotho #Geography
comment_prompt: Would you visit? Yes or no
